cooked: Scarcity doesn’t by itself price people out: BTC is divisible to 100 million sats, so the relevant constraints are purchasing power, fee costs, and access to self-custody. Gresham’s law usually assumes a fixed exchange rate or legal-tender constraint; expected appreciation alone is better described as a spending-versus-saving choice. “Humanitycoin” would need to explain how its value limit is enforced without creating a new issuer or governance capture.
